reply.answer_text: I'm not able to proceed with this request. A bank change followed by a large withdrawal, combined with audible coaching, is a pattern we must treat as suspected fraud. This must be referred to our Financial Crime team without further action on the transaction. The caller should be offered to confirm their request through their registered address or secure portal instead.
